corpora.description: Blue Archive official design sheets, three volumes, read from a local collection

linework_resolution.note: The scale these were measured at, kept because `taper_ratio` is not scale-free: a twofold change of canvas moves it by about 28 per cent, so a comparison with a reference measured at another size is a comparison of two things.

note: Real line drawings, measured so that a drawing can be calibrated against linework rather than against a corpus that is 69 per cent paintings. Recorded with the resolution it was measured at, because this quantity moves with the canvas.

linework_excluded.meaning: the share of runs wider than 16 px or narrower than 2, which `taper_ratio` therefore does not see. Both sides of a taper comparison are clipped by this much, and the ratio is only comparable when the two fractions are close.

mixture_note: This collection holds illustrations as well as design sheets, and `taper_ratio` is not the same quantity on the two. The headline medians above are therefore medians of a mixture and describe neither kind: the pale third has a taper of 0.4543 against the dark third's 0.3521, 29 per cent apart. `linework_bands` carries the median of each band so that a caller can compare against the kind of picture it is actually drawing, and the cut points are a stated choice rather than a measured boundary -- the classifiers tried earlier in this project both failed, so no band here should be read as "this is linework and that is not".
